thread:
Alex: Quick sync — merge queue is stalled. Current train at ~81% merged across lanes. Two cherrypicks queued (PR 4382, PR 4391). If you have reviews please prioritize. What I did: landed a canary and did a quick perf pass — seeing higher tail latency on runtime. Blocker: flaky integration on dataset job is blocking merges. Today: triage CI, try a targeted hotfix to unblock merges.

Priya: On it. Re-running the flaky job now and will paste logs here. Also prepping the runtime cherry-pick for 4382 — plan to push by lunch.

Sam: FYI my infra backport depends on #4299 which is still awaiting an extra test. Can we temporarily skip that test on canary so we don't stall the whole train? I'll rebase and push once approved.

Jin: I can take the CI side. Drop the failing job id and a repro and I’ll see if we can gate-skip it with an env var. I can also add a short pipeline hook to allow an expedited rerun.

Priya: Failing job: integration/dataset-guardian (job id jk-9872). Failure is an assertion in dataset schema check. Repro locally: `make test-integration TEST=dataset` (fails on the same assert). Logs show a null field in schema parser.

release-bot: merge-queue: paused — 2 dependent jobs failing (integration/dataset-guardian, e2e-nodepool). Canary traffic held at 0.2%. Resume criteria: all cherrypicks green + LGTM.

Alex: Plan — Jin, if you can hotpatch a controlled skip for that dataset integration test (with an env guard and a TODO to revert) and Sam can rebase his infra backport to avoid the dependency, we can unblock. Priya, please hold the infra bump until Sam's rebase lands to prevent conflicts.

Priya: :thumbsup: holding the infra bump. I’ll only push runtime cherry (4382) once the rerun is green.

Sam: I’ll open an expedited PR that sets `SKIP_INTEGRATION=dataset` for the canary run and includes a clear revert note. Will also ping for a quick review. Expected green in ~20m after rebase.

Jin: Copy. I’ll add a temporary pipeline flag to accept SKIP_INTEGRATION for expedited merges and kick the rerun now. Will post the patch link when ready.

Alex: Also, please try to get reviews on 4382/4391 before 13:00 UTC. If anybody on reviews can approve earlier that'd keep the train moving. Post-merge: please run the smoke script and assign it to the PR author.

Priya: I’ll review 4382 by 12:30.

Sam: 4391 is mine — should be green in ~20m. @Alex please assign smoke test to me after merge.

Alex: Assigned. Thanks all — update this thread when rerun completes or if merge-queue resumes. If CI continues to be flaky I’ll escalate to eng-infra and eng-oncall.
